setting.meaning: 不锈钢接轴相对普通45#钢接轴工艺的正式加工附加成本
previousReaders: quotation/order configuration and cost snapshot construction through the same shared rotorShaftJoint service
setting.newReader: api/services/currentRecipeCost.cjs through resolveRotorProcessMode when a Recipe Scenario Preview selects stainless_shaft_joint

baseline.authority: Current Recipe rows have no persisted Rotor Process column in the current schema; the existing business model defines the unconfigured/default process as ordinary 45# steel. The Scenario Preview therefore uses standard_45_steel unless a temporary override selects stainless_shaft_joint.
baseline.scope: Preview only; no migration and no Recipe persistence behavior were added.
baseline.persistenceGap: A later persistent Recipe Rotor Process feature needs an explicitly reviewed storage contract and write workflow.

formalCostPath: scenario comparison candidate and formal delta
